changelog: In-Chat Copilot Setup & 1-Tap Sign In: When switching to Copilot on an empty chat, a dedicated setup card appears immediately on screen with 1-tap 'Sign in with GitHub', device code dialog popup, clear step-by-step instructions, and PAT option without needing to navigate into Settings

Clean Agent Switching & Ghost Chat Prevention: Switching agents on an empty screen no longer spawns ghost conversations or unwanted workspace folder branches; chats are only materialized and saved to disk when the first message is sent, and previous empty ghost chats are cleaned up

React Bits Redesigned Top Bar: Modern futuristic header featuring 'ShinyText' dynamic gradient shimmer across the chat title, an animated breathing pulse dot matching the active agent's signature accent (Cyan, Terracotta, or Purple), an interactive glass breadcrumb capsule ('• Agent › 📁 Workspace ▾'), and frosted glass circular navigation
